test_title: PYST 39: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Height of seven boys M, N, O, P, Q, R and S are given as follows. Only one person is shorter than Q. S is the tallest. R is taller than P but shorter than O. P is not the shortest. N is shorter than only one person. Who is the third tallest among the boys?
solution:
Given: Height of seven boys M, N, O, P, Q, R and S are given as follows.

1) Only one person is shorter than Q.

__ > __ > __ > __ > __ > Q > __

2) N is shorter than only one person.

__ > N > __ > __ > __ > Q > __

3) S is the tallest.

S > N > __ > __ > __ > Q > __

4) R is taller than P but shorter than O.

5) P is not the shortest.

S > N > O > R > P > Q > __

And, 'M' will place on the remaining position, and it gives 'M' is the shortest person.

S > N > O > R > P > Q > M

So, **'O'** is the third tallest among the boys.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
